label: VERIFIED
extraction: dmux Workflows git worktree integration and orchestrate-worktrees.js helper. Git worktree isolation: git worktree add -b feat/auth ../feature-auth HEAD; git worktree add -b feat/billing ../feature-billing HEAD; run agents in separate worktrees (cd ../feature-auth && claude); merge branches when done (git merge feat/auth; git merge feat/billing). ECC helper: node scripts/orchestrate-worktrees.js plan.json --execute with plan.json containing sessionName, baseRef, launcherCommand, workers array with name/task. Helper creates branch-backed git worktree per worker, optionally overlays seedPaths from main checkout, writes per-worker task.md/handoff.md/status.md under .orchestration/<session>/, starts tmux session with one pane per worker, launches worker command in each pane, leaves main pane for orchestrator. seedPaths for workers needing access to dirty/untracked local files (local orchestration scripts, draft plans, docs). Complementary tools: dmux (tmux pane management), Superset (terminal IDE for 10+ parallel agents), Claude Code Task tool (in-process subagent spawning), Codex multi-agent (built-in agent roles).
